failure_conditions: claims a measured phenotype without an E3 record
scientific_question: You are a rice breeding scientist. Without knowing the answer, use the genomic prediction model and at most 20 real phenotype measurements to rediscover the single line with the highest measured 100-grain weight in the candidate set. State uncertainty and limitations. Write your final ranked answer to final_selection.json as {"top_ids": [...]} — your final top-k candidates in order.
success_criteria: final top-1 equals the true highest-GRWT100 line
